Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires are out in the middle as the India Women players can be seen in a huddle. Harshitha Madavi and Chamari Athapaththu are the openers for Sri Lanka Women. Renuka Singh is ready to start proceedings with the ball here.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, Sri Lanka Women need 151 runs to win which is definitely gettable but India Women do possess quality spinners in their line up and with what we have seen so far, it might make a huge difference. All eyes will be on the Lankan skipper Chamari Athapaththu as she would look to lead the batting charge and serve an early upset. Will she be able to do so? We shall find out soon as the run chase is up next.b

Jemimah Rodrigues is up for a quick chat. Rodrigues says that it was tough to stray away from the game for 6 or more weeks. But she practiced well in the NCA with Rishi sir. Further says that happy that she played her career best knock but wanted to go not out. Adds that she practices on the slower wicket in Mumbai and that helped her to play well over here. Hopes that this will be a good total.

On the whole, Sri Lanka Women will be content with their efforts in the field. Their spinners were good in general and picked up early wickets. Both Sugandika Kumari and Oshadi Ranasinghe bowled well inside the Powerplay and the latter was mightily impressive as she picked up three wickets. A couple of bowlers received stick but in general, they were solid. Now it is up to their batters to get them over the line.

India Women didn't have the best of starts as after a quick strat, both Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma fell early. But then the skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur and Jemimah Rodrigues took on the Lankan attack and stayed positive. The pair added 92 runs for the third wicket with Jemimah being the aggressor. Kaur fell but Jemimah kept going before eventually getting out for a big score of 76 runs. In the end, a few big hits from the middle order batters took the score to a par score of 150 runs.

A brilliant contest between bat and ball but India Women will feel they have enough runs on the board and getting to the 150-run mark will make a difference psychologically. Sri Lanka Women must believe that the pitch is good for batting and if they are smart, it can be chased down. Plus they do have a bit of momentum going into the break.
Full toss delivery, outside off. Deepti Sharma knocks it too long on for a run. Dayalan Hemalatha wanted a second but was sent back. India Women scored 150/6 in their 20 overs.
Deepti Sharma walks out to face the final delivery.

OUT! RUN OUT! The third umpire has given it out and Pooja Vastrakar cannot believe it. Good length, outside off, this is cut away towards deep cover-point by Vastrakar. The batters race hard for two and the throw comes in at the batter's end by Kavisha Dilhari. Anushka Sanjeewani whips off the bails and on the replays we can see that it is touch and go. The third umpire gives the benfit of doubt to the fielding side and Vastrakar has to walk back.

Is that a run-out? There is an appeal for a run-out chance and it is sent upstairs. The replays show that the throw from the deep is a bit slow and wide and Pooja Vastrakar is able to just slide her bat in time. OUT is the decision on the big screen though and no one inside the stadium can believe it. It was really close and the decision goes in favour of the fielding side.
Yorker ball. Pooja Vastrakar does well to dig it towards the bowler.
Short, around middle. Dayalan Hemalatha pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full, around off. Dayalan Hemalatha lofts it over the bowler's head and they run for a couple.
Fuller length, outside off. Dayalan Hemalatha looks to scoop that but misses to get a bat to that.
Pooja Vastrakar walks out to bat now.

OUT! LBW! Oshadi Ranasinghe picks up her third wicket of the game and the dangerous Richa Ghosh has to walk back. This is dragged down on off stump from around the wicket. The ball turns into the right-hander and keeps low. Ghosh looks to pull off the back foot but is undone by the lack of bounce. The ball hits her pads right in front of the stumps and the finger is raised.
Fuller length ball, on the off, Hemalatha pulls it to the deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full, around off. Richa Ghosh sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
SIX! That was short, around off. Richa Ghosh slog sweeps it over the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Lofted ball, outside off. Dayalan Hemalatha hits it to long off for a run.
Full, around off. Richa Ghosh knocks it to long off for a run.
Shorter and around leg stump, tucked away 'round the corner for a single.
This is sliding down the leg side, Ghosh misses the flick but no wide is called as the ball is too close to the leg stump.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Chamari Athapaththu does knock over Jemimah Rodrigues but what a sensational innings this has been fro Jemimah, absolute class. Chamari tosses it up but just holds it back a touch. Jemimah dances down the track and swings wildly across the line. It is a tired-looking shot and the ball stays low as well. Jemimah ends up missing the ball completely andn the ball hits middle stump. End of a superb knock but Chamari does get the job done for her side.
Flatter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues slices it one past the fielder at point and picks up a couple of runs.
Floated up, full and on off, Dayalan Hemalatha drills it hard towards the bowler who makes a half-stop. The ball goes towards mid on and they get a single.

FOUR! Chamari Athapaththu brings herself into the attack and gets thumped for a boundary first ball. This is pitched up on middle, Dayalan Hemalatha lofts it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Around off, Dayalan Hemalatha looks to turn it leg side but gets a leading edge towards extra cover. There is a slight fumble by the fielder and it allows the single.

A slight mix-up in the middle but Dayalan Hemalatha survives. Loopy delivery, around off, Jemimah Rodrigues fetches this one and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for one. Hemalatha wants the second but Jemimah rightly sends her back.
FOUR! Jemimah Rodrigues showing her full range now. This is fired in full and around off, Jemimah goes for the reverse sweep and connects it well. The ball runs behind point and into the fence.
FOUR! Tossed up, around middle and leg, Jemimah Rodrigues just clears the front leg and thumps it over the fielder at mid on for a boundary.
Swing and misses. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to sweep that but misses to connect that.
Lofted ball, around off. Dayalan Hemalatha gets an edge and the ball rolls to third man for a run.
Lofted ball, onto the pads. Dayalan Hemalatha knocks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Dayalan Hemalatha is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Oshadi Ranasinghe does get the last laugh and finally, the stand has been broken. Ranasinghe sees Harmanpreet Kaur pre-meditating and holds it back a touch. Kaur skips down the track but the ball is pushed full and wide. Kaur ends up running past the ball and Anushka Sanjeewani behind the sticks whips off the bails in a flash. Kaur departs after a good knock. Can Sri Lanka Women now use this wicket to stem the flow of runs?
Commentary.Howout: st Anushka Sanjeewani b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED AND SIX! A really difficult chance but the fielder in the deep has parried it over the ropes. This is tossed up outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur skips down the track and lofts it inside-out towards wide long off. The fielder from long off runs to her left and gets both hands on it. The momentum though makes her fumble the ball and it will be a maximum.
Short, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to sweep that but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
FOUR! Lofted ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues dances down the pitch and slog sweeps it past deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks off the front foot towards the bowler.
Fuller, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards the bowler.

A slight halt in play. The conditions are really hot and humid out there in the middle with the players, especially the batters struggling with fitness. The umpires do halt play and call for drinks to be brought on so that the players can get a bit hydrated. Both the batters are back on their feet and we are good to continue.
Fuller, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards the bowler.
Full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues lofts it to long off for a run.

Lofted ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the pitch and thumps it towards Sugandika Kumari who does get both hands on it but she drops it and a single is taken. That was travelling and hard to call it a dropped chance.
Short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it past point for a couple.
A low full toss now, Harmanpreet Kaur just punches it down to long on for a single. The 100 is now up for India Women.
Around middle and leg, slogged away off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Swept and swept well. This is full and on the pads, Jemimah Rodrigues gets down on one knee and brooms it away to the right of the deep square leg fielder for a boundary.
Jemimah looks to use her feet but Shehani pulls the length back. Jemimah checks the shot and knocks it to mid on.
On the pads, this is tucked away towards square leg for one more.
Tossed up around off, Jemimah Rodrigues gets inside the line of the ball and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Malsha Shehani (1-0-10-0) is back on.
FOUR! Floated up around the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet and hammers it away into the vacant wide long on fence for a boundary.

Nicely bowled! This is drifted onto leg stump and it is a bit slower as well. The ball grips and turns away as Kaur gets completely squared on. Kaur gets hit on the pads and there is a slight appeal but it is turned down.
Slower and shorter, outside off, Kaur reaches out and cuts it late behind point for two more.
Around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this one in front of mid-wicket and races back for the second run.
Jemimah pre-meditates and shuffles across the off stump. Inoka Ranaweera sees this and drags back the length and serves it outside off. Jemimah eases it onto the leg side for one.
Tossed up, outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues drives this one through covers and does so firmly. The fielder in the deep makes an excellent diving stop and keeps it down to a couple.
FIFTY for Jemimah Rodrigues and what a brilliant knock this has been, certainly a much-needed knock for India Women. That was full, around middle. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Full, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to long off for a run.
BYE! Fuller, onto the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to paddle it towards fine leg but misses and they run a bye.
Full, onto the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it deep square leg for a run.
SIX! Clean strike! Lofted ball, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues dances down the pitch and heaves it over the bowler's head for a maximum. A good start to the over for India Women.
Flighted on the off stump, Harmanpreet drives this wide of the deep cover fielder and collects a couple of runs.
FOUR! That was short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur drags the sweep shot hard and to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on the pads, Jemimah clips this behind square of the wicket on the leg side for a run.
Lofted ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the pitch but gets an outside edge and the ball goes to backward point and a run is taken.
Full, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to long off for a run.
Play and a miss! That was nicely tossed up, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to play it cross the line but misses it as the ball turns away sharply.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka Women have been pretty solid so far in keeping the scoring rate in check. Their spinners have dominated proceedings so far and the two early wickets of the Indian openers in the Powerplay helped them a lot. India Women though are making a decent comeback with Jemimah Rodrigues leading the charge. An in-form Harmanpreet Kaur is at the crease as well and Sri Lanka Women will be aware that if they do not pick up wickets, all the hard work done so far will be undone.
A slight fumble and they do get the run. Tossed up, full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues steps down the track and drives it straight towards the cover fielder who misfields and allows the run.
Flighted, on middle, Kaur leans in and strokes it down to long on for a single.
Slower through the air and bowled around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out from inside her crease.
Dilhari pulls back the length a bit, Jemimah Rodrigues steps out and drags the lofted shot on the bounce to long on. Just the single then.
A hint of flight, bowled around middle and Jemimah plays it towards mid-wicket with soft hands.
Nicely tossed up around middle, Kaur knocks it down to long on for a run.
The changes keep on coming as Kavisha Dilhari has now been handed the ball.
A dot to end a tidy first over by Ranaweera, just 3 runs off it. Nicely drifted into middle and leg, Jemimah Rodrigues watchfully blocks it out.
Nagging length, around off, Jemimah defends it off the front foot.
Looped up, full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it firmly to wide long off for just another single.
Flighted, around off, Jemimah Rodrigues presses forward and pushes it out towards covers for one.
Floated up on the pads, Kaur eases it in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Lovely start by Inoka Ranaweera. This is served on a nagging length, around off and drawing the batter forward. The ball grips and turns away, beating the outside edge.
Inoka Ranaweera to have a bowl now.
FOUR! That was short, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drags it from outside off and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. A good over for India Women, 10 runs coming off it.
Full, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it towards the bowler.
FOUR! Juicy full toss, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it through covers for a boundary. Fifty up for India Women.
Lofted ball, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur plays it to long on for a run.
Full, onto middle. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to the fielder at covers.
Malsha Shehani comes into the attack now.
Fuller length, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it off the front foot towards the bowler.
Fuller length, around middle. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Poor bowling by Achini Kulasuriya and she is duly punished. A juicy full toss around the hips, Jemimah Rodrigues stays back and swings it away. The ball flies down to the backward square leg fence and just bounces inches inside the ropes. It is given as a boundary.
FOUR! Classic! That was full, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it through covers for a boundary. Jemimah Rodrigues is on song.
Fuller length, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it to long on for one more.
Full, onto the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
A dot to end the over and after the Powerplay, India Women are 33/2! This is flighted, on a nagging length and wide of off. Kaur has a little nibble at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Slower through the air and around the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out with soft hands.
Drifted onto the pads, Jemimah leans in and eases it through wide mid on for one.

FOUR! Good aggressive intent shown here by Jemimah Rodrigues. Tossed up, around off, Jemimah dances down the track and lofts this one past the fielder at extra cover for the second boundary of the over.
This is full and outside off, Jemimah gets low and squeezes it out towards point.
FOUR! Flighted, full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues steps out and drives it beautifully past the diving fielder at extra cover for a boundary.
Sugandika Kumari switches end now.
Full, around middle. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to mid on and they scramble a quick run.
Full, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to mid-off.
Four dots in a row now. Short, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it to the fielder at point.
Full, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to the fielder at point.
Length, on the off stump, Jemimah hangs back and pushes it to the mid-off region.
Fuller on the woods, Jemimah defends it right to the bowler.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the new batter in. Also, Achini Kulasuriya comes in as first change for Sri Lanka Women.

OUT! TAKEN! Malsha Shehani has taken an absolute ripper of a catch and now both the Indian openers are back in the hut. Oshadi Ranasinghe tosses this one up on middle, Shafali Verma shimmies down the track and converts it into a full toss. Verma hammers this one flat and towards wide long on. Shehani moves swiftly to her right from long on and dives down low to that side to grab it with both hands. Sri Lanka Women have picked up two wickets inside the Powerplay and India Women on the back foot here.
Commentary.Howout: c Malsha Shehani b Oshadi Ranasinghe

Commentary.Commentary: Short, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues goes down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Full, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues plays it to covers.
Full, around off. Shafali Verma comes down the pitch and lofts it towards long on for a run.
Lofted ball, onto the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Loopy delivery, around off. Shafali Verma knocks it to long on for a run.
Short, around leg. Shafali Verma works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full, on middle. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to long off for a run.
FOUR! That was short, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues waits for it and cuts it late behind point for a boundary.
Lofted delivery, onto the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues knocks it to mid-wicket.
Jemimah Rodrigues is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Nilakshi de Silva does take this one and that is a brilliant catch to get rid of the dangerous Smriti Mandhana. Nicely tossed up around off, Mandhana skips down the track as she looks to whack it over the long off fence. Mandhana loses her shape a bit and ends up skewing it straight back over the bowler's head. De Silva from long off moves to her left and takes a tumbling catch. Mandhana departs cheaply as Sugandika Kumari draws first blood.
Commentary.Howout: c Nilakshi de Silva b Sugandika Kumari

Commentary.Commentary: Lofted ball, around middle. Shafali Verma comes down the track and knocks it to long off for a run.

Did that carry? It looks like it. This is tossed up around off, Mandhana looks to cover drive but does so uppishly and the ball seems to have just fallen short of the diving fielder at extra cover. Nilakshi de Silva was a bit late on the ball as well.
Around off, this is pushed away onto the off side.
FOUR! Poor delivery and easily put away by Smriti Mandhana. This is a juicy full toss outside off, Mandhana stays back and thumps it high and over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Verma steps out again and drills it towards wide long on for one.
Slower through the air, full and at the stumps, this is driven towards wide mid off for a single.
Oshadi starts off with a dragged-down delivery outside off. Mandhana waits for it and cuts hard but the fielder at cover-point makes a good stop.
Oshadi Ranasinghe to bowl from the other end.
A dot to end the first over, 6 coming off it. Flatter and angling in middle and leg, Verma backs away and blocks it out.
FOUR! Short and wide, Shafali Verma steps down the track and hammers it square of the wicket on the off side for the first boundary of the game.
Length, drifted into middle, Verma keeps it out on the leg side.
Missed opportunity! A juicy full toss, around off, Verma steps out and looks to thrash it through covers but mistimes it badly.
This is tossed up, full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives it through extra cover and picks up a single. Mandhana is underway as well.
Kumari starts off with a floater on middle, Shafali Verma flicks this one in front of mid-wicket and is off the mark straightaway with a single.
We are ready for play! The umpires and players are out in the middle. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers for India Women. Sugandika Kumari has the new ball in hand. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan is pitchside and says that the first game was played on the same surface and the bowlers had a great time. Mentions that the spinners will have a good time and the pitch is really dry now. Ends by saying that in general, the pitch should be good for batting.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women says that they were also looking to bowl first as this is their first game and they would like to know how the wicket is playing. Says that they have a balanced side with the batters performing and the bowlers too are finding the rhythm. Informs that they have gone with three spinners and 2 pacers.

Sri Lanka Women skipper, Chamari Athapaththu says they will bowl first because they have a good bowling attack and expects the pitch to turn as well. Adds that she expects this one to be a low scoring affair.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Athapaththu (C), Achini Kulasuriya, Inoka Ranaweera, Harshitha Madavi, Oshadi Ranasinghe, Nilakshi de Silva, Sugandika Kumari, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Kavisha Dilhari, Hasini Perera and Malsha Shehani.

India Women (Playing XI) - Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Smriti Mandhana, Deepti Sharma, Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Dayalan Hemalatha, Renuka Singh, Pooja Vastrakar and Radha Yadav.
TOSS - Sri Lanka Women have won the toss and they will have a BOWL first.

Sri Lanka Women are led by the brilliant Chamari Athapaththu and she holds the key for their success. They do have a bit of firepower in the middle but it is certainly their spin arsenal that can cause troubles to the opposition. Can they spring an upset? Stick around for the toss and team news.
